title: Permit Pipeline — eBPF Observability
description: Zero-instrumentation kernel-level metrics for the Azure permit processing pipeline. All data captured via eBPF probes — no SDK changes required.

panels.title: TCP Socket Latency p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)
panels.description: Kernel-level round-trip time for all TCP connections made by the permit API and function. Segmented by destination: Azure Storage (queue), PostgreSQL, HTTP.

panels.title: eBPF Events / sec by Destination Port
panels.description: Rate of captured TCP events per destination. Spikes indicate bursts of queue polling or database activity.

panels.title: Azure Storage Queue Latency p99 (ms)
panels.description: p99 socket RTT to port 443 (Azure Storage HTTPS). Elevated values indicate queue saturation or network congestion.
